name: app-project-timeline-staggered-cards-with-week-pills
title: Staggered Project Timeline Cards
whatItIs: A grey slide titled Project Timeline with four alternating cards (Research, UI/UX Design, Prototype & Test, Final Delivery), each with a vertical rounded duration pill, an icon, a description and dotted elbow arrows leading to the next.
whatItMeans: Alternating blue and lilac cards with arrows make sequence and duration clear at a glance.
techniques: Cards stepping left and right down the page
Vertical duration pills in blue and lilac
Small icon in a white circle per card
Header with numbered title and tag list

vocabulary.definition: A vertical rounded label showing how long a phase takes.
A right-angled dotted arrow linking cards.
Items placed left then right to create a zigzag.
